import hashlib

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


async def record_login(session: AsyncSession, account) -> None:
    fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(account.email.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
    session.add(account)
    await session.commit()
    log.info("login recorded account_fp=%s", fingerprint)
